name: codex-skills
description: Codex skills for research, App Store readiness, Codex model routing, deep repository review, Swift review, PR feedback triage, and safe branch cleanup.

interface.shortDescription: Research, Codex routing, review, and Git workflows.
interface.longDescription: Continue research, audit apps before App Store submission, coordinate coding work across available agents, evaluate repository technologies, run model-aware whole-repository audits or change reviews, run Swift-specific review, sort PR feedback, and remove merged local branches.
defaultPrompt: Continue research with continue-deep-research; audit App Store readiness with appstore-readiness-audit; coordinate independent coding work with codex-routing; assess repository technologies with research-repo-technology; calibrate model-aware repository audits or change reviews with deep-code-review; review Swift changes with swift-code-review; verify PR feedback with triage-review-comments; clean merged branches with git-clean-merged-branch.
